questions.question: PA and PB are tangents to a circle with centre O, from a point P outside the circle, and A and B are points on the circle. If ∠APB = 30°, then ∠OAB is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c046e0a57722e3bc9141e995d0f88df9321269b8c0c0a993c79e3536ac71b77d.png] 

Since tangent AP makes right angle with radius OA

∴ ∠OAP = 90°

In ΔAOP,

∠AOP + ∠APO + ∠PAO = 180°

⇒ ∠AOP + 15° + 90° = 180°

⇒ ∠AOP = 75°

⇒ ∠AOB = 2 × ∠AOP = 150°

Now, in ΔOAB,

∠AOB = 150°

⇒ ∠OAB + ∠OBA = 30° (∵ OA = OB, ∴ ∠OAB = ∠OBA)

∴ ∠OAB = 15°

questions.question: An article is priced at Rs. 40,000. A retailer allows 10% discount on the first 62.5% of the price. On the remaining amount, he gives a discount of 4%. Then the overall percentage discount given on the article is:
questions.solution:
62.5% of 40000 = 25000 and 10% of 25000 = 2500

Discount on the remaining amount = 4% of (40000 - 25000) = 600

⇒ Total discount offered = 2500 + 600 = 3100

∴ Overall percentage discount = 3100/40000 × 100 = 7.75%

If a sum of money on compound interest becomes three times in 4 years, then at the same interest rate, the sum will become 27 times in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a sum becomes **n** times in **t** years at compound interest, it becomes **nx** times in **x × t** years.

Given, sum becomes 3 times (3¹) in 4 years.

We need to find the time for the sum to become 27 times.

Since 27 = 3³, the multiplier x = 3.

Time required = 3 × 4 = 12 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sum of money at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years.

Let Principal = P, Rate = R%, Amount = A, Time = n years.

 
• 
 
 
 0 yrs
 P

 
 4 yrs
 3P

 
 8 yrs
 9P

 
 12 yrs
 27P

 

 × 3

 

 × 3

 

 × 3

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Total Time = 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3P = P(1 + R/100)⁴

⇒ 3 = (1 + R/100)⁴ — (Equation 1)

Let the sum become 27 times in n years.

⇒ 27P = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ 27 = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ 3³ = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

Substitute the value of 3 from Equation 1:

⇒ [(1 + R/100)⁴]³ = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ (1 + R/100)¹² = (1 + R/100)ⁿ

On comparing the powers of both sides:

⇒ n = 12 years

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Multiplier Rule

If a sum becomes **x** times in **T** years at a constant compound interest rate, it will become **xⁿ** times in **n × T** years.

Contrast with Simple Interest (SI)

In Simple Interest, if a sum becomes 3 times in 4 years, the interest earned is 2P in 4 years. To become 27 times, the required interest is 26P. It would take (26 ÷ 2) × 4 = 52 years in SI.

Important CI Formats

For half-yearly compounding: Rate becomes R/2 and Time becomes 2T. For quarterly compounding: Rate becomes R/4 and Time becomes 4T.

questions.question: A person goes to his office at 1/4th of the speed at which he returns from his office. If the average speed during the whole trip is 15 km/h, then what is the speed of the person while he was going to his office?
questions.solution:
Let the person goes to office at x km/h and returns from office at 4x km/h. The distance from one side be d km.

Average speed = Total Distance/Total Time

⇒ 15 = (d + d) / {(d/x + d/4x)}

⇒ x = 75/8 km/h

questions.question: If x+(1)/(x)=4, then {{x}³}+(1)/({{x)³}} is equal to:
questions.solution:
x + 1/x = 4

Taking cube both the sides,

[x + 1/x]³ = 4³

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3[x + 1/x] = 4³ {(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b)}

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3 [x + 1/x] = 64

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ + 3[4] = 64

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 64 - 12

⇒ x³ + 1/x³ = 52

questions.question: If a-(1)/(a)=3. then {{a}⁶}+(1)/({{a)⁶}} is equal to:
questions.solution:
a - 1/a = 3

Taking cube both sides,

(a - 1/a)³ = 3³

a³ - 1/a³ - 3(a - 1/a) = 27{(a³ - b³) = a³ - b³ - 3ab(a - b)}

a³ - 1/a³ - 3(3) = 27

a³ - 1/a³ = 27 + 9

a³ - 1/a³ = 36

Squaring both the sides, we get

(a³ - 1/a³)² = (36)²

a⁶ - 2 × a³ × (1/a³) + 1/a⁶ = 36²

∴ a⁶ + 1/a⁶ - 2 × 1 = 1296

∴ a⁶ + 1/a⁶ = 1298

questions.question: A sphere of radius 5 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such complete spheres can be made?
questions.solution:
**Formula:** Volume of sphere = 4/3 × πr³

Volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × 5³

Volume of new spheres = 4/3 × π × 2³

∴ Required number of spheres = (4/3 × π × 5³) / (4/3 × π × 2³)

= 125/8 = 15.625

∴ 15 spheres can be made.

questions.question: If a³ - b³ = 210 and a - b = 5, then (a² + b²) + ab is equal to:
questions.solution:
(a³ - b³) = 210 and a - b = 5

⇒ (a³ - b³) = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ 210 = 5 × (a² + ab + b²)

⇒ 210/5 = (a² + ab + b²)

∴ (a² + ab + b²) = 42

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is the diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 150°. ∠BAC is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42abe848fb50960c96f3f6968dab8112044ef09d14e0ee8f87cca46c4d447d7c.png] 

In a quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is equal to 180°.

Since ABCD is cyclic quadrilateral,

∴ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

According to the question, AB is diameter.

∴ ΔABC will be a right angle triangle.

⇒ ∠C = 90°

In ΔABC,

∠BAC + ∠ABC + ∠ACB = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC + 30° + 90° = 180°

⇒ ∠BAC = 60°

questions.question: If (x - 4)³ + (x - 5)³ + (x - 3)³ = 3(x - 4)(x - 5)(x - 3), then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Suppose (x - 4) = a, (x - 5) = b and (x - 3) = c

**Formula****∶ **If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

(x - 4)³ + (x - 5)³ + (x - 3)³ = 3(x - 4)(x - 5)(x - 3)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

⇒ a + b + c = 0

⇒ x - 4 + x - 5 + x - 3 = 0

⇒ x = 4

questions.question: 3 men, 4 women and 6 boys together can complete a work in 5 days. A woman does double the work a man does and a boy does half the work a man does in a day. How many women alone can complete this work in 7 days?
questions.solution:
Let the required number of women be x.

A woman does double the work a man does in a day

⇒ W = 2M ----(1)

A boy does half the work a man does in a day

⇒ M = 2B ----(2)

Now, using the formula M₁D₁/W₁ = M₂D₂/W₂

⇒ (3M + 4W + 6B) × 5 = x × W × 7

⇒ (3M + 8M + 3M) × 5 = x × 2M × 7

⇒ 14M × 5 = 14M × x

⇒ x = 5 W

questions.question: Given that, ΔABC~ΔQPR and (ar(ABC ))/(ar( QPR ))=(9)/(16). If AB = 12 cm, BC = 6 cm and AC = 9 cm, then PR is equal to:
questions.solution:
In the similar triangle,

[Area of ΔABC] / [Area of ΔQPR] = BC²/PR²

⇒ (9/16) = (6²/PR²)

∴ PR² = 16 × 4

∴ PR = 8 cm

questions.question: A earns Rs. 80 per hour and works for 8 hours a day. B, earns Rs. 60 per hour and works for 6 hours a day. What is the ratio of per day wages of A and B?
questions.solution:
Per day income of A = 80 × 8 = 640

Per day income of B = 60 × 6 = 360

Ratio of per day wages of A and B is = 640 ∶ 360 = 16 ∶ 9

questions.question: If cos θ + sec θ = 2, then (cos¹¹⁷ θ + sec¹¹⁷ θ) is equal to:
questions.solution:
∵ x + 1/x = 2

⇒ x² + 1 = 2x

⇒ x² - 2x + 1 = 0

⇒ (x - 1)² = 0

⇒ x = 1

∴ xⁿ + 1/xⁿ = 2

Similarly, cosθ + 1/cosθ = 2

∴ cos¹¹⁷θ + 1/cos¹¹⁷θ = 2

questions.question: If 3cos² A + 7sin² A = 3, 0° ≤ A ≤ 90°, then the value of A is:
questions.solution:
3cos² A + 7sin²A = 3

⇒ 3cos² A + 3sin² A + 4sin²A = 3

⇒ 3 + 4sin² A = 3

⇒ 4sin² A = 0

⇒ sin A = 0 = sin 0°

⇒ A = 0°
